items.source: This resolver requires XsltView.
items.translation: 此解析器需要 `XsltView`。

items.source: The following source types are supported out of the box: Source, Document, Node, Reader, InputStream and Resource.
items.translation: 默认支持以下源类型： Source、Document、 Node、Reader、InputStream 以及 Resource。

items.translation: 描述从类复制：UrlBasedViewResolver

items.source: buildView in class UrlBasedViewResolver
items.translation: `buildView` 在类 `UrlBasedViewResolver` 中

items.source: If not set, a default SimpleTransformErrorListener is used that simply logs warnings using the logger instance of the view class, and rethrows errors to discontinue the XML transformation.
items.translation: 如果未设置，将使用默认的SimpleTransformErrorListener，该监听器仅通过视图类的 logger 实例记录警告，并重新抛出错误以中止 XML 转换。

items.source: Default is true (on); set this to false (off) to not specify an "indent" key, leaving the choice up to the stylesheet.
items.translation: 默认为 `true`（开启）；将其设置为 `false`（关闭），则不指定 "indent" 键，将选择权留给样式表。

items.source: Subclasses will typically call super.buildView(viewName) first, before setting further properties themselves. loadView will then apply Spring lifecycle methods at the end of this process.
items.translation: 子类通常会首先调用 `super.buildView(viewName)`，然后再自行设置其他属性。`loadView` 随后将在该过程的末尾应用 Spring 生命周期方法。

items.source: The URIResolver handles calls to the XSLT document() function.
items.translation: URIResolver 处理对 XSLTdocument()函数的调用。

items.source: Spring lifecycle methods as defined by the bean container do not have to be called here; those will be applied by the loadView method after this method returns.
items.translation: 由 Bean 容器定义的 Spring 生命周期方法不必在此处调用；这些方法将在本方法返回后，由 `loadView` 方法应用。

items.source:
Any values specified here will override defaults that this view sets
programmatically.
items.translation: 此处指定的任何值都将覆盖该视图通过编程方式设置的默认值。

items.source:
The default value is "true". Only set this to "false" in development,
where caching does not seriously impact performance.
items.translation: 默认值为 "true"。仅在开发环境中将其设置为 "false"，此时缓存不会严重影响性能。

items.source: The default implementation uses reflection to instantiate the class.
items.translation: 默认实现使用反射来实例化类。

items.source: ViewResolver implementation that resolves instances of XsltView by translating the supplied view name into the URL of the XSLT stylesheet.
items.translation: 实现`ViewResolver`接口，通过将提供的视图名称转换为 XSLT 样式表的 URL 来解析`XsltView`实例。

items.source: Set an implementation of the ErrorListener interface for custom handling of transformation errors and warnings.
items.translation: 为自定义处理转换错误和警告，设置一个 ErrorListener 接口的实现。

items.source: Return the required type of view for this resolver. This implementation returns AbstractUrlBasedView.
items.translation: 返回此解析器所需的视图类型。此实现返回AbstractUrlBasedView。

items.source: Creates a new View instance of the specified view class and configures it.
items.translation: 创建指定视图类的新 View 实例并对其进行配置。

items.source: Instantiate the specified view class.
items.translation: 实例化指定的视图类。

items.source: Return the required type of view for this resolver.
items.translation: 返回该解析器所需的视图类型。

items.source: Turn on/off the caching of the XSLT templates.
items.translation: 打开/关闭 XSLT 模板的缓存。

items.source:
Set whether the XSLT transformer may add additional whitespace when
outputting the result tree.
items.translation: 设置 XSLT 转换器在输出结果树时是否可以添加额外的空白。

items.source: Set arbitrary transformer output properties to be applied to the stylesheet.
items.translation: 设置任意转换器的输出属性，这些属性将应用于样式表。

items.source: Set the name of the model attribute that represents the XSLT Source.
items.translation: 设置代表 XSLT 源（Source）的模型属性名称。

items.source: Set the URIResolver used in the transform.
items.translation: 设置转换中使用的 URIResolver。
